title: equisetum ramosissimum var. humile
intro: Equisetum ramosissimum var. humile, commonly known as Dwarf Horsetail, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family and is one of the most ancient vascular plants on Earth. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving kidney function, and supporting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Equisetum ramosissimum var. humile include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
